name: business-os-cloudflare
description: Business OS on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 + Queues (Docker-free runtime)

scripts.migrate:local: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 migrations apply business-os --local
scripts.migrate:remote: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 migrations apply business-os --remote
scripts.migrate:import:local: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 migrations apply business-os-import --local
scripts.migrate:import:remote: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 migrations apply business-os-import --remote
scripts.deploy:full: npm run typecheck && npm run build:frontend && npm run migrate:remote && npm run migrate:import:remote && npm run secrets:sync && npm run deploy
scripts.d1:shell:local: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 execute business-os --local --command
scripts.d1:shell:remote: node scripts/with-wrangler-auth.cjs wrangler d1 execute business-os --remote --command
